broll: Real budgeting situations; bills, receipts, salary day, banking/payment actions, expense tracking, calculator, everyday purchases. Use anonymized or clearly labelled mock data.
elements: Animated income→expense flow, category bars, budget buckets, currency counters, glassmorphic card callouts.
motion: Smooth Ease-Out (Cubic): Bars grow smoothly from bottom/left; numbers roll up with odometer easing; cards slide in with soft 15–20px vertical drift and subtle drop shadow.
palette_text: Primary #142B45 (trust navy); Secondary #1F8A70 (financial growth); 3rd #E8E2D6 (warm neutral); 4th #D95D39 (risk/attention, sparingly).
music: Minimal lo-fi, warm piano, understated electronic pulse; calm and practical, not luxury-hype.
sfx: Calculator taps, receipt/paper rustle, soft UI clicks, subtle ticks; restrained transition swishes.
delivery: Calm authority, practical, reassuring, non-judgmental. Never shame people about money.
hook: Specific money pain point, surprising expense, myth-vs-fact, small actionable promise.
rhythm: Medium pace; punch-in on key figures; hold charts long enough to read; clean cuts and subtle wipes.
notes: Show currency, period and assumptions. Label illustrative numbers. Avoid guaranteed returns, fake account screens and get-rich-quick visuals.

broll: Verified market context, dated charts, company/product footage, exchange screens, risk examples, analyst at work. Make demo data visibly illustrative.
elements: 2D candlestick/line charts, trendline reveals, risk/reward scales, portfolio pie/donut slices, dated source badges.
motion: Precision Linear-to-Ease: Trendlines draw left-to-right via stroke trim (Trim Paths); chart nodes pop with minimal overshoot (100%→103%→100%); camera pans smoothly along chart peaks.
palette_text: Primary #101820 (charcoal); Secondary #2D6A8A (analytical blue); 3rd #D9E2E8 (cool light grey); 4th #E0A526 (caution amber). Red/green only for semantically correct market movement.
music: Restrained electronic pulse, minimal ambient tension, soft tech percussion; avoid casino-like energy.
sfx: Soft data ticks, chart draw, muted alert, restrained digital whoosh; no jackpot sounds.
delivery: Measured, skeptical, analytical, composed; never sound certain about uncertain outcomes.
hook: Risk reveal, chart misconception, what a metric does/doesn't tell you, scenario question.
rhythm: Medium-slow; pause for chart interpretation; animate one data point at a time; avoid rapid chart flashes.
notes: Show source and date. Separate fact, opinion and forecast. Avoid personalized buy/sell calls and certainty claims.

broll: Founder/workspace, product making, packaging, customer journey, team operations, storefront, real business process, service delivery.
mg_style: Modern Isometric / Modular Card UI Style
elements: Funnel diagrams, unit economics stacks, customer journey maps, comparison cards, revenue/cost blocks.
motion: Snappy Spring-Back: Cards stack sequentially with 3-frame stagger; connecting arrows draw smoothly; active metric block scales up (105%) while background dims slightly.
music: Modern corporate groove, mellow upbeat electronic, light percussion; optimistic but grounded.
sfx: Keyboard, paper, packaging sounds, subtle UI clicks, light whoosh and soft impact.
delivery: Confident, candid, curious; communicate trade-offs and lessons from failure.
hook: Unexpected business insight, costly mistake, margin reveal, mini case study.
rhythm: Medium-fast; section changes on idea shifts; animate metrics in sequence; avoid flashy transitions.
notes: Label sample size, timeframe and illustrative numbers. Avoid unexplained revenue screenshots and generic luxury montages.

broll: Journaling, daily routine, workspace, walking, phone distraction, planning, small habit moments, relatable everyday life.
elements: Habit loops, hand-drawn highlighter strokes, notebook checklists, 3-step ladders, subtle 2.5D photo parallax.
motion: Organic / Boil Effect (12fps texture): Highlighter sweeps behind keywords like a real marker; pencil circles draw around key words; gentle floating drift (2–3px slow loop) on cards.
music: Warm piano, gentle acoustic guitar, soft ambient beat, mellow lo-fi.
sfx: Page turn, pencil writing, soft taps, room tone, gentle riser into the insight.
delivery: Empathetic, reflective, encouraging, grounded; avoid preaching or toxic positivity.
hook: Reframe a common struggle, relatable question, unexpected practical insight.
rhythm: Medium pace; let meaningful lines breathe; use simple text reveals and occasional slow push-in.
notes: Give one practical action. Avoid shaming language, miracle transformation promises and overused stock motivation shots.

broll: Training, practice repetitions, early morning preparation, focused work, setbacks, craft, consistent effort, quiet wins.
elements: Full-screen 1–5 word punch phrases, milestone counters, progress bars, subtle grain/film overlay.
motion: Hard Slam / Expo-Out: Words slam into frame with slight camera shake (4–6px decay); rapid scale-down (140%→100%) synced to beat/vocal stress; zero slow fades.
music: Cinematic percussion, rising strings, hybrid trailer pulse, energetic instrumental; build then drop for emotional line.
sfx: Footsteps, breath, fabric movement, gym foley, restrained deep hit, short riser.
delivery: Conviction, urgency, resolve, controlled intensity; not constant shouting.
hook: Strong challenge, consequence, direct command, contrast between intention and action.
rhythm: Fast build with one or two slow holds; hard cuts on action; impact only on the main payoff.
notes: Use 1–5 word emphasis phrases. Avoid nonstop zooms, constant impacts, shame-based messaging and fake luxury imagery.

broll: Natural conversations, listening, quiet room, phone messages recreated, social situations, everyday behavioral moments; protect privacy.
elements: Thought bubbles, decision trees, behavior loops, spectrum sliders, torn-paper or textured note cards.
motion: Gentle Elastic & Wiggle: Hand-drawn lines wobble subtly (2–4fps boil); spectrum slider glides smoothly between extremes; cards peel or unfold gently to match reflective pacing.
palette_text: Primary #34445C (slate blue); Secondary #8B7AA8 (muted lavender); 3rd #F1ECE7 (soft neutral); 4th #C98F76 (warm terracotta).
music: Soft ambient, mellow piano, minimal downtempo; avoid melodramatic sadness.
sfx: Room tone, subtle phone buzz, gentle swish, soft tap; sparse and natural.
delivery: Curious, compassionate, nuanced, non-judgmental; avoid diagnosing the viewer.
hook: Reflective question, common misconception, behavior reframe, relatable mini-scenario.
rhythm: Medium-slow; allow pauses after questions; use subtle push-ins and clean chapter cards.
notes: Define psychological terms. Distinguish research from interpretation; don't label or diagnose people from a short clip.

broll: Clinician demonstration, accurate anatomy, safe everyday health behavior, medical setting, equipment, evidence-based procedure footage.
elements: Translucent body/organ overlays, symptom timelines, step-by-step checklists, amber/red warning badges.
motion: Calm, Controlled Ease-In-Out: Anatomical highlights pulse softly (opacity 60%→100%); callout lines extend cleanly from body part to text label; hold frames steady for readability.
palette_text: Primary #174A63 (clinical blue); Secondary #2A9D8F (teal); 3rd #F4F7F7 (clean white); 4th #E6A23C (warning amber). Use red #C94C4C only for genuine urgent warnings.
music: Light neutral ambient, gentle piano, clean understated pulse; no horror tension.
sfx: Soft UI ticks, subtle swish, restrained alert only when medically appropriate.
delivery: Reassuring, precise, responsible, calm; urgency only for real red flags.
hook: Question that corrects a misconception; symptom context; when to seek professional help.
rhythm: Medium; slow down for instructions and caveats; hold safety cards long enough to read.
notes: Use qualified sources and dates. Avoid miracle-cure claims, diagnosis, fear tactics and misleading before/after visuals.

broll: Correct exercise form, coach demonstration, gym details, muscle action, equipment, side-by-side form comparison.
elements: Joint-angle arcs, muscle-group highlights, rep/timer counters, movement path arrows, split-screen form boxes.
motion: Fast-Lock & Track: Angle lines track real body joints frame-by-frame; rep numbers punch in (scale 120%→100% in 4 frames); motion paths trace reps in real time.
music: Driving electronic, energetic hip-hop instrumental, athletic percussion; avoid overpowering vocals.
sfx: Foot plant, barbell clink, controlled breath, rope/cloth movement, subtle whoosh.
delivery: Energetic coach, supportive, specific, safety-aware.
hook: Demonstration-first, common form mistake, measurable training question.
rhythm: Fast demo cuts; hold correct form long enough to see; use match cuts and slow motion selectively.
notes: Label exercise context, reps and modifications. Never glamorize unsafe form or body-shame.

broll: Ingredient close-ups, cooking process, portion scales, food labels, texture, meal preparation, relevant kitchen activity.
elements: Cutout ingredient badges, macro/nutrient bars, portion comparison circles, food label magnifying boxes.
motion: Playful Pop / Overshoot: Cutout food stickers pop in with white border and slight rotation (-4° to +2°); nutrient bars fill fluidly like liquid; zoom-loupe expands smoothly over labels.
music: Light acoustic, playful marimba, gentle kitchen groove, warm upbeat instrumental.
sfx: Chop, sizzle, pour, plate clink, packaging rustle, soft pop.
delivery: Curious, practical, non-moralizing; avoid fear around food.
hook: Unexpected food fact, comparison, cooking-method question, label-reading hook.
rhythm: Medium; sensory B-roll inserts; clean match cuts and gentle speed changes.
notes: Show serving size and units. Avoid universal diet claims, food fear and misleading portion visuals.

broll: Archival photographs, maps, artifacts, real locations, paintings, documents; label reenactments and illustrations honestly.
mg_style: Papercraft / Archival Parallax + Map Route Style
elements: Vintage paper cutouts, animated ink map routes, territory shading, 2.5D archival photo layers, wax/stamp dates.
motion: 2.5D Camera Push + Ink Bleed: Foreground cutouts separate from background photos (parallax depth); red/sepia route lines draw organically across maps; textures animate at 8–12fps stop-motion feel.
music: Orchestral/folk textures, low strings, period-appropriate instruments, restrained cinematic ambience.
sfx: Paper, quill, page turn, distant crowd/ambience, subtle cinematic hit.
delivery: Narrative curiosity, gravity, wonder; measured and respectful.
hook: Mini story, turning-point question, surprising historical detail, consequence reveal.
rhythm: Story-led pacing; map and timeline reveals; slow push-ins on stills; restrained film grain.
notes: Verify dates, names and quotations. Distinguish established facts from disputed accounts; no fake archival material.

broll: Verified location footage, maps, infrastructure, official statements, dated headlines, relevant public-domain/ licensed visuals.
elements: Topographic/vector maps, stakeholder node webs, dated headline clippings, territory borders, timeline scrubbers.
motion: Measured Documentary Pan & Zoom: Camera glides across map coordinates (Ease-In-Out); borders highlight via soft glow; headline cards slide in with crisp 1px border reveals.
palette_text: Primary #263746 (slate navy); Secondary #54758A (steel blue); 3rd #E5E8E8 (light grey); 4th #B65B50 (muted red, conflict only).
music: Restrained documentary pulse, low ambient, minimal percussion; avoid patriotic or partisan cues.
sfx: Subtle radio texture, paper, map pin, restrained low hit, quiet transition.
delivery: Serious, analytical, even-handed; avoid outrage performance.
hook: Context gap, overlooked stakeholder, timeline question, what changed and why.
rhythm: Medium-slow; give context before conclusion; use map/timeline reveals and calm cuts.
notes: Date-stamp developing facts. Label allegations vs confirmed facts. Avoid graphic violence and misleading map scales.

broll: Real product demos, screen recordings, lab/process footage, hardware macro, real-world use cases, verified experiments.
mg_style: Tech / Futuristic HUD + Node Pipeline Style
elements: System architecture pipelines, glowing data packets, terminal/code UI windows, wireframe models, node networks.
motion: Digital Snap & Flow: Data dots travel along vector paths; UI windows open with fast vertical wipe + 1-frame flicker; text types on with monospace cursor blink.
music: Minimal electronic, soft synth pulse, clean tech ambient, subtle rhythmic texture.
sfx: UI clicks, data ticks, restrained digital glitch, soft whoosh, device foley.
delivery: Curious, precise, cautiously excited; clearly state limitations.
hook: Can it really do X? Demo-first, surprising limitation, myth-vs-reality.
rhythm: Medium-fast; alternate speaker and demo; animate one system step at a time.
notes: Show software/version/date and test conditions. Avoid fake interfaces and treating one demo as universal proof.

broll: Real-world examples, classroom/desk, object demonstration, diagrams, relevant environment, simple experiments.
elements: Analogy icons, numbered stage badges, progressive build diagrams, color-coded keyword pills.
motion: Step-by-Step Sequential Build: One visual element enters per spoken idea; smooth morphing between simple shapes; clear directional wipes (Left→Right) guiding the viewer's eye.
music: Light upbeat instrumental, marimba/piano, soft electronic groove.
sfx: Marker draw, page flip, soft click, gentle transition swish.
delivery: Friendly teacher, confident, patient, encouraging.
hook: One-minute promise, analogy, common confusion, question-led explanation.
rhythm: Steady pace; each step gets one visual beat; use simple wipes and progressive reveals.
notes: One concept per video. Avoid tiny labels, unexplained jargon and decorative motion that competes.

broll: Forms, public office exterior, document close-ups with personal data hidden, process footage, relevant official websites.
mg_style: Official Document UI + Structured Process Style
elements: Highlighted legal/form clauses, eligibility checkboxes, deadline calendars, step-by-step flowcharts.
motion: Crisp, Authoritative Slide: Document zooms smoothly to the exact clause; yellow/gold highlight bar sweeps across text; checkmarks draw cleanly into boxes without bounce.
music: Neutral corporate ambient, calm piano, understated pulse.
sfx: Paper shuffle, stamp, subtle UI ticks, restrained page transitions.
delivery: Clear, reassuring, careful, measured; never alarmist.
hook: Checklist hook, common paperwork mistake, process clarification, deadline reminder.
rhythm: Medium pace; hold checklists; use clear step-by-step transitions.
notes: Show jurisdiction and update date. Distinguish general information from legal advice. Hide personal data.

broll: Actual screen recording, cursor close-ups, before/after workflow, shortcut demonstration, desk setup.
elements: Custom spotlight cursors, magnified UI zoom boxes, floating keyboard shortcut caps (Ctrl+C), progress bars.
motion: 1:1 UI Responsiveness: Cursor glides smoothly with click-ripple effect; zoom boxes scale up with smooth spring (250ms); shortcut keycaps press down (scale 92%) on click.
music: Light electronic groove, unobtrusive lo-fi, soft upbeat pulse.
sfx: Mouse click, keyboard taps, muted notification, subtle confirmation tick.
delivery: Helpful, brisk, competent, patient at complex steps.
hook: Time-saving promise, one shortcut, before/after workflow, result-first demo.
rhythm: Fast during clicks, pause after result; zoom into active UI; use clean cuts.
notes: Use real interface and version. Keep cursor visible and readable; avoid fake UI and overly fast screen capture.

broll: Location-specific streets, transport, food preparation, local craft, architecture, ambient details; film respectfully.
mg_style: Postcard / Scrapbook Collage + Route Map Style
elements: Animated flight/road routes, location pins, polaroid/postcard frames, price & time tags, stamp overlays.
motion: Tactile Drop & Drift: Location pins bounce onto map (Overshoot); postcards drop in at slight angles (±3°) with subtle paper texture; smooth match-cut transitions between locations.
music: Regionally appropriate instrumental, acoustic/folk textures, warm light groove.
sfx: Street ambience, footsteps, market chatter, utensil sounds, transport ambience.
delivery: Wonder, warmth, discovery, respectful curiosity.
hook: Hidden place, local detail, unexpected comparison, “what to do first” hook.
rhythm: Medium-fast montage with slower establishing shots; location reveals and match cuts.
notes: Verify place names, prices and seasonal context. Avoid cultural stereotypes and intrusive filming.

broll: Verified locations, documents, evidence-style recreations clearly labelled, atmospheric empty spaces, non-graphic context footage.

elements: Red-string connection webs, redacted document callouts, forensic timelines, surveillance-style map zooms.
motion: Slow Tension Creep: Continuous ultra-slow scale-in (100%→106%); red strings draw tightly between suspect/event cards; typewriter text reveal with muted flicker.
music: Low drone, restrained pulse, sparse strings, minimal percussion; controlled suspense.
sfx: Room tone, distant ambience, paper handling, subtle low hit, quiet texture.
delivery: Controlled suspense, sober empathy, respect for victims; avoid theatrical excitement.
hook: Timeline contradiction, overlooked detail, unanswered question with a factual payoff.
rhythm: Slow reveal, measured cuts, minimal glitch; let evidence and narration carry tension.
notes: Label allegations vs convictions. Avoid graphic imagery, accusing unconvicted people and sensational victim framing.

broll: Real workplace, collaboration, presentation, portfolio, interview preparation, feedback and mentoring moments.
mg_style: Clean Corporate UI + Framework Diagram Style
elements: Career ladders, 2x2 priority matrices, feedback loops, role comparison cards, Slack/email-style prompt bubbles.
motion: Structured Grid Alignment: Matrix quadrants expand cleanly from center; cards glide into aligned grid slots with crisp deceleration; active quadrant highlights via border glow.
palette_text: Primary #26394A (professional navy); Secondary #4F7D72 (muted green); 3rd #F1F0EA (warm white); 4th #D49A52 (muted amber).
music: Modern light corporate, mellow upbeat, soft piano/electronic blend.
sfx: Keyboard, page turn, subtle UI click, light office ambience.
delivery: Supportive mentor, honest, constructive, confident but not arrogant.
hook: Common career frustration, practical checklist, misconception, scenario question.
rhythm: Medium pace; clean chapter breaks; use lower-thirds and simple diagrams.
notes: Qualify advice by role, country and industry. Avoid universal promotion or salary promises.

broll: Everyday family activities with consent, hands/toys/activities, parent-child interaction, home routines; protect children's privacy.
mg_style: Warm Hand-Drawn + Soft Card / Scrapbook Style
elements: Daily routine cards, age-stage milestones, gentle choice trees, friendly icon badges, soft rounded callouts.
motion: Soft, Rounded Bounce: Cards float in with gentle ease-out (no harsh impacts); hand-drawn underlines sweep smoothly; icons gently nod or tilt (±5°) to feel approachable.
music: Soft acoustic, warm piano, light ambient; gentle and reassuring.
sfx: Toy movement, page turn, room tone, soft fabric and household foley.
delivery: Gentle, validating, patient, non-judgmental.
hook: Relatable parenting moment, question, practical routine, myth correction.
rhythm: Slow-medium; leave space for empathy; use gentle cuts and calm text cards.
notes: Use age/context qualifiers. Avoid parent shaming and absolute developmental claims. Obtain consent and protect child identity.

broll: Fabric texture, product detail, fit demonstrations, styling variations, grooming process, accurate product close-ups.
elements: Before/after wipe sliders, silhouette proportion lines, color palette swatches, ingredient/product callout pins.
motion: Silky Fashion Wipe: Vertical/horizontal split-screen line glides smoothly; color swatches fan out like a deck; thin hairline pointers extend gracefully to outfit/product details.
music: Stylish light electronic, fashion-house percussion, mellow groove.
sfx: Fabric swish, zipper, product click, soft camera shutter, light whoosh.
delivery: Confident, playful, inclusive, tasteful.
hook: Visual transformation, styling mistake, product detail, one practical tip.
rhythm: Fast comparisons; hold details long enough to inspect; use clean match cuts and subtle speed ramps.
notes: Disclose paid/sponsored content. Keep product colors accurate. Avoid body shaming and altered results presented as natural.

delivery: Passionate craft expert, curious, precise, demonstrative.
hook: Result-first reveal, “why this works”, common mistake, process breakdown.
rhythm: Medium pace; demonstrate in steps; use split-screen comparisons and purposeful speed ramps.
notes: Show settings and context. Avoid unexplained jargon, cluttered overlays and effects without a teaching purpose.

sfx: Newsroom room tone, paper, soft alert tick, restrained transition.
delivery: Credible, composed, empathetic, evidence-led.

rhythm: Medium; clear chaptering; show dates and source labels; avoid frantic cuts.

broll: Relevant memes or clips with rights awareness, expressive hands/body language, objects, reaction cutaways, context footage.

hook: Unexpected comparison, absurd observation, relatable question, punchline-first.

notes: Do not overuse meme SFX. Respect clip rights and context; avoid misleading edits or targeted harassment.
